name: Taberna da Rua das Flores
description: Tiny, authentic taberna in Chiado serving modern Portuguese small plates. Locals love it for creative dishes using traditional ingredients. Book ahead or arrive early.

name: Park Bar
description: Rooftop bar hidden atop a parking garage with stunning city views. Totally unexpected and beloved by locals. Grab drinks at sunset.

name: Alfama
description: Lisbon's oldest neighborhood with narrow winding streets, fado houses, and authentic local life. Get lost here on purpose.

name: Time Out Market
description: Food hall featuring 40+ stalls from Lisbon's best chefs and restaurants. Great for sampling multiple cuisines. Can be touristy but quality is high.

name: Pensão Amor
description: Former brothel turned eclectic bar with vintage decor, live music, and creative cocktails. Unique Lisbon nightlife experience.

name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
description: Best panoramic viewpoint in Lisbon. Locals come here to watch sunset. Bring wine and snacks.

name: Cervejaria Ramiro
description: Legendary seafood spot. Order the garlic shrimp, percebes, and finish with a prego steak sandwich. Expect lines but worth it.

name: Red Frog
description: Speakeasy-style cocktail bar with no sign. Ring the doorbell and enjoy expertly crafted drinks in intimate setting.

name: Jardim da Estrela
description: Beautiful garden park where locals picnic, read, and relax. Grab pastries from nearby Pastelaria Versailles and enjoy.

name: A Cevicheria
description: Peruvian-Portuguese fusion with incredible ceviche. Chef Kiko brings creativity and quality. Small space, book ahead.
